abstract: The rate of reduction in the concentration of serum human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) following chemotherapy for germ cell tumours may follow a complex pattern, with longer apparent half-life during later stages of chemotherapy, even in patients treated successfully. The commonly used half-life of less than 3 days for hCG to monitor the effect of chemotherapy in patients with germ cell tumours of the testis may represent too simple a model. 125I-labelled hCG was injected intravenously in 27 patients with germ cell tumours and elevated hCG during chemotherapy. The plasma radioactivity and hCG concentrations were followed. During chemotherapy, the plasma disappearance of hCG showed a biphasic pattern, with an initial fast and a later slow component in all patients. Using the steep part of the hCG plasma disappearance curve, five patients who achieved long-term remission had half-lives longer than 3 days (3.6-6.8 days), whereas four out of five patients not achieving long-term remission had half-lives shorter than 3 days. After the third treatment cycle, eight patients who achieved long-term remission had hCG half-lives longer than 3 days (7.4-17.0 days). In these patients, the plasma disappearance of [125I]hCG was equivalent to that of hCG. Thus, the slow decline of hCG represented a slow plasma disappearance rather than a hCG production from vital tumour cells and could, consequently, not be used to select patients for additional or intensified chemotherapy. The concept of a fixed half-life for plasma hCG during treatment of hCG-producing germ cell tumours is inappropriate and should be revised. Difficulties in interpreting a slow decline of hCG may be overcome by comparing the plasma disappearance of total hCG with the plasma disappearance of [125I]hCG.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)濃度の低下速度は、化学療法の経過中に複雑なパターンを示すことがあり、治療に成功した患者においても後期の段階では見かけ上の半減期が長くなる。化学療法中にhCGが上昇した胚細胞腫瘍患者27例に125I標識hCGを静脈内投与した。化学療法中の血漿中放射能とhCG濃度を追跡した。化学療法中、全例でhCGの血漿中消失は、初期の速い成分と後期の遅い成分からなる二相性を示した。hCGの血漿中消失曲線の急峻な部分を用いると、長期寛解を達成した5例は半減期が3日を超え(3.6～6.8日)、長期寛解に至らなかった5例中4例は半減期が3日未満であった。3回目の治療サイクル後、長期寛解を達成した8例は半減期が3日を超えていた(7.4～17.0日)。これらの患者では[125I]hCGの血漿中消失はhCGのそれと同等であった。したがって、hCGの緩やかな低下は、hCG産生腫瘍細胞の生存を反映するのではなく、血漿中からの緩徐な消失を反映しており、追加または強化化学療法の対象となる患者の選択には用いることができない。hCG産生性胚細胞腫瘍の治療中に血漿hCGの固定半減期を用いる考え方は不適切であり、見直されるべきである。hCGの緩やかな低下の解釈の困難さは、総hCGの血漿中消失を標識hCGの血漿中消失と比較することで克服できるかもしれない。
